welcome:
**Welcome to MIGRA-IA.** Two ways to use it; the first one **needs no API key and costs nothing**.

• **Interactive demo** — here **you** answer. Your equipment is identified against the verified catalog of **30 manufacturers, 130 generations and 469 CPU models**; the questions and their options come from the master questionnaire; the risk engine scores **your** answers; the decision map says what is in order for **your** case and, if migrating is the way, the **50-step** procedure guides you with the target CPU you choose (same brand or another). No language model: same case, same result, every time.

• **Real case (API)** — free-form dialogue with the complete agent. It is the one thing the demo cannot do, and it needs your ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in the .env file.
